svg.title: Prithvi Raghu: research and selected work
svg.desc: I study computer science at VIT Vellore and research quantum machine learning and scientific computing. I build quantum convolutional networks, study multiplayer quantum games and compare circuit encodings for option pricing. I also model HF radio propagation and evaluate ionospheric corrections for emitter geolocation. QHD: co-authored manuscript, equilibrium analysis and recorded IBM Heron experiments for multiplayer quantum games. FQCNN: co-authored manuscript, unitary pooling and reproducible classical simulations across four classification tasks. QOP: manuscript draft and reproducible encoding comparisons for Asian-basket pricing, with explicit logical-resource limits. HF geolocation: hybrid ionospheric models and Gaussian-process correction, evaluated with simulated emitter geometry.

g.text: I study computer science at VIT
